verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an API endpoint for bulk-deleting accounts and visitors (the article is titled 'Bulk delete accounts and visitors through the API'), so it has its own bulk capability. That capability covers only one operation type on two entity types. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond deletion (e.g., bulk update or tagging of guides, segments, or features), documentation of batch sizes and limits, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
